messages.english: Enter nursery tray dimensions in centimetres or inches.
messages.translation: Dzhenisani mielo ya dzithirei dza tsimu ya zwimela zwiṱuku nga dzisentimitha kana dziintshi.

messages.english: Enter usable nursery surface in square metres or square feet.
messages.translation: Dzhenisani vhupo vhu shumisekaho ha tsimu ya zwimela zwiṱuku nga dzimitha dza tshikwere kana dziṋayo dza tshikwere.

messages.english: Keep nursery entries until their save is confirmed.
messages.translation: Litshani zwidodombedzwa zwo dzheniswaho zwa tsimu ya zwimela zwiṱuku zwi tshi kha ḓi vha hone u swika u vhulungwa hazwo hu tshi khwaṱhisedzwa.
Nangani dziyuniti dza tsimu ya zwimela zwiṱuku
Pulane ya mveledziso → Mupulani wa tsimu ya zwimela zwiṱuku

messages.english: Choose your units, enter tray sizes and usable growing surface, then save. Unknown equipment values stay blank; zero stock stays zero.
messages.translation: Nangani dziyuniti dzaṋu, dzhenisani vhuhulu ha dzithirei na vhupo vhu shumisekaho ha u aluwa ha zwimela, u bva afho ni vhulunge. Mielo ya zwishumiswa i sa ḓivhei i dzula i si na tshithu; tshiṱoko tsha zwishumiswa tsha zero tshi dzula tshi zero.
